specification.scope: Numerical candidate-model study, not measured performance or spatial calibration
specification.binding_policy: named physical study instrument; os/seed recorded separately; cannot match production run calibration binding
specification.band_power_scope: Welch constant-detrended final half-phase windows; 7.8125 kHz bins, summed through 50 kHz, excludes unresolved low-frequency power
specification.uncertainty_scope: t intervals over independent runs, not correlated pixels; fixed-finest arm uses paired differences due to shared calibration fit; fractions use bounded Hoeffding intervals, including zero observed invalid counts

interpretation: Execution/CRC success is not statistical equivalence. Inconclusive intervals and invalid coverage remain explicit. Bias uses valid pixels only; full-field accuracy is not established.
omitted_from_summary: Per-replicate waveforms/spectra and per-bin details; reproduce from preserved raw files or fixed seeds.
